page.layout: One page of text, single column of dictionary entries with Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac words; running head at top, page number at top right. No marginal notes of substance; faint show-through from the reverse page in the margins is ignored.

main_text.p: חבושא Ch. Idem, Genef.40.20. in T. Hierof.
חנב חנבא Ch. Locusta, Levit.11.22. Plur. חנבין.
חנג Ch. Festum celebravit, Feriatus est: item Tri-pudiari, quòd id festis diebus agere solerent.
חנא, חג חנא Ch. Festum, festivitas. Plur. חנין חניא.
חגה חגוין Ch. Fissurae, ut Hebraicè. Plural. constr. בחגוי טנרא In fissuris petrae, Cantic.2.14.
חנס Ch. Cuniculus. Plur.conft. חנסי Cuniculi, Proverb.30.26. Hebr. שפנים.
Syr. Claudus. Plur. ܚܢܣܝ, Matt.21.14. Idem quod sequens חגיר. ם enim & ר, ut litterae homogeneae, solent inter se permutari.
חגר Ch. Claudicare, וחגר Et claudus redditus est, 2.Sam.4.4. Hebr. ויפסח.
חגר פום וחגר ממלל חגירא, חגיר, חגיר Ch.& Syr. Claudus: Claudus ore & claudus sermone, id est, Balbus, Exo. 4.10. in Jon. Plur. חגירין.
חגרא Ch. Chagra, nomen proprium loci, Gen.16.7. qui Hebr. שור.

חד חד Ch. & Syr. Unus, primus: Per aphaeresin primae litterae ab Hebraeo אחד. Foem. חדא, חרה Una. Geminatum חד, חד, Unusquisque, quilibet, singuli. Hinc Sol, (quem ut Deum coluerunt) à gentibus Orientalibus, Assyriis ac Phaenicibus vocatus est etiam Adad, cujus nominis interpretatio est, Unus, scribit Macrob.in Saturnal.lib.1.cap.23.&21.

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac words are transcribed as closely as the scan allows; Syriac and some pointed Hebrew forms are approximate. Dictionary-entry breaks follow the printed lines. The short Syriac line at the foot is uncertain.
